case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests praised the convenient location by the Gulbenkian Museum; many described breakfast as good to excellent, while several called it crowded or average. Room feedback was mixed: some said rooms were clean and spacious; others reported dated decor, noise, dirty curtains/windows, uncomfortable beds and maintenance issues. Parking was described as tight; staff were praised, with isolated reports of slow check‑in, a disputed room‑service charge and a fire alarm.
